item.text: {"confident":true,"explanation":"The trapezoidal update gives (1+Δx)y_{n+1}=(1-Δx)y_n, so I is true. Stability requires |(1-Δx)/(1+Δx)|<1, which holds for every Δx>0; thus III is true. II is false: at Δx=2 its expression equals 1.5, although the actual amplification factor is -1/3.
